newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares fluctuate and fall, outlook promising.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares fluctuate and fall, outlook promising.

text.p: Danish share prices closed lower on Friday after a day of major fluctuations, with dealers seeing the possibility of a revival next week after recent days of correction and Wall Street got off to a good start.
"I think prices have bottomed out for the time being at their current level, the U.S. started well so things look good for next week," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index closed 0.11 point down at 126.76 in overall bourse turnover of 1.059 billion crowns. The KFX December future rose 0.45 point to 127.60 with 190 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.
Banks were in focus after a report by British investment bank HSBC James Capel foreseeing upcoming mergers in the Nordic banking sector.

Den Danske Bank closed four crowns lower at 419, while rival Unidanmark shed only one crown to finish the week at 270, with 250,000 shares changing hands. Third biggest bank BG Bank closed unchanged at 253.
